title: 第7章 天价功法第8章 真假银票
slug: 绑定全国每人每天给我一两银
lines: 茶州城，繁华喧嚣。
刚刚杀完人的陆舟，走出宅院后，步伐平稳，直奔本城最大的商会。
这是他前世今生的第一次杀人。
比想象中要轻松，也比想象中要畅快。
前身憋屈至死，连反抗的勇气都没有。
如今虽只是斩了一个趋炎附势的家奴，却像是解开了陆舟心中枷锁，第一次感受到力量带来的爽感。
变强，一定要不断变强！
唯有如此，方能立足世间，无人敢欺压！
身后，周川和李雄默默跟随，偶尔的目光交汇，都看出了彼此心中的困惑。
尤其是李雄。
佩刀被拔，他其实有所反应。
但对方的果决，还是出乎了他的意料。
这样一个人，真的是传说中软弱无能，柔弱可欺的废物吗？
他深深地看着前方背影，心绪翻腾。
这王爷……难道真的在藏拙？
不多时，三人来到了茶州城最大的商会——流云商会！
面前，五层楼阁高耸而立，雕梁画栋气派非凡，来往人群络绎不绝。
踏入商会，眼前是一片开阔恢宏的大厅。
正中央是一条楼梯，台阶铺设着柔软地毯，扶手更是雕刻着精美花纹。
左侧，鎏金镶边的柜台一路延伸，尽显奢华，右侧则是一幅巨大的山水画，笔墨传神，栩栩如生，一眼惊艳。
陆舟初来乍到，便想着先了解了解云州的情况，向柜台侍者一问，得知负责情报类的管事在三楼。
三人随即上楼。
整个流云商会，共有五层。
一层接待，二层和四层则是兜售各种商品之处，至于第五层，那是只有商会最尊贵的客人才能涉足之地。
据说，在那里藏着整个商会最珍贵的商品，奇珍瑰宝无数，寻常人连看都没资格看一眼。
到了三楼。
人比想象中要更多一些。
宽阔的大厅，人满为患，里三层外三层，声音嘈杂，似乎在围观什么。
周川主动上前，询问得知，原来前些日子商会得了一门一流高阶功法，今日特意展示，一来彰显商会深厚底蕴，二来借此造势招揽四方客源。
陆舟眉梢微挑。
一流高阶功法，这可不多见！
大周武朝，武技与武道境界持平，都分九品。
唯有功法自成体系，划为三流、二流、一流、宗师四阶。
每一品阶，又分初、中、高、顶级四等。
content_en:
Chazhou City is bustling and bustling.
Lu Zhou, who had just finished killing someone, walked out of the house and walked straight to the largest chamber of commerce in the city.
This was his first murder in his previous life.
It's easier than imagined, and more enjoyable than imagined.
The predecessor was so depressed that he didn't even have the courage to resist.
Even though he had just beheaded a domestic slave who was following Yan Yan, it felt like he had untied the shackles in Lu Zhou's heart and felt the pleasure of power for the first time.
To become stronger, you must keep getting stronger!
Only in this way can we stand in the world and no one dares to bully us!
Behind him, Zhou Chuan and Li Xiong followed silently. Occasionally their eyes met, and they could see the confusion in each other's hearts.
Especially Li Xiong.
When the saber was pulled out, he actually reacted.
But the other party's decisiveness still exceeded his expectations.
Is such a person really the weak, incompetent, weak and bullied good-for-nothing in the legend?
He looked deeply at the figure in front of him, his mind churning.
Is this prince... really hiding his clumsiness?
Not long after, the three of them arrived at the Liuyun Chamber of Commerce, the largest chamber of commerce in Chazhou City!
In front of you, there is a towering five-story pavilion with extraordinary carved beams and paintings, and there is an endless stream of people coming and going.
Stepping into the Chamber of Commerce, you will see an open and magnificent hall in front of you.
In the center is a staircase. The steps are paved with soft carpets and the handrails are carved with exquisite patterns.
On the left side, the gilt-edged counter stretches all the way, showing luxury, while on the right side is a huge landscape painting, which is vivid and lifelike, and is stunning at first sight.
When Lu Zhou first arrived, he wanted to get to know the situation in Yunzhou first. After asking the waiter at the counter, he learned that the manager in charge of intelligence was on the third floor.
The three of them immediately went upstairs.
The entire Liuyun Chamber of Commerce has a total of five floors.
The first floor is for reception, the second and fourth floors are for selling various goods, and the fifth floor is where only the most distinguished guests of the Chamber of Commerce can set foot.
It is said that the most precious commodities of the entire chamber of commerce are hidden there, with countless rare treasures that ordinary people are not even qualified to take a look at.
Arrived on the third floor.
There are more people than you think.
The spacious hall was full of people, with three floors inside and three floors outside. There were noisy voices, as if they were watching something.
Zhou Chuan took the initiative to step forward and inquired. He learned that the Chamber of Commerce had obtained a first-class high-level martial art a few days ago, and it was specially displayed today. Firstly, it showed the profound heritage of the Chamber of Commerce, and secondly, it was used to build momentum to attract customers from all over.
Lu Zhou raised his eyebrows slightly.
First-class high-level skills are rare!
In the Wu Dynasty of the Great Zhou Dynasty, martial arts and martial arts were at the same level, and both were divided into nine levels.
Only the exercises form their own system, divided into four levels: third-rate, second-rate, first-rate, and master.
Each level is divided into four levels: elementary, middle, high and top.
